verdict.rationale: Community reports describe LiveKit as a self-hostable SFU built on Pion ion-sfu, so media does route through a selective forwarding unit. However, no first-party doc in the pack describes SFU routing or confirms that only each participant's subscribed tracks are forwarded. The subscribe-only token example concerns permissions, not selective forwarding. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the SFU architecture, documented per-participant selective track subscription/forwarding, hands-on corroboration of subscription-based delivery.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, media routes through a selective forwarding unit or relay that delivers only the tracks each participant subscribes to

citations.quote: They called it the right choice for a modern SFU you run yourself.
Also liked that it builds on the well-reputed, battle-hardened Pion ion-sfu.
